card.fires_on: The word "of" right after "example" or "examples", where a category is about to be illustrated. It also fires weakly on "of" after "way".

modes.label: Example of
modes.description: "of" right after "example(s)" introducing a list or an instance of a class.

modes.label: Way of
modes.description: "of" after the noun "way" before an activity.
modes.example: Brick Stacking is a way<< of>> making new bricks from existing ones.
